answer_text:
Here are some of the best places to find the latest stock market news:

### 📊 Top Sources for Stock Market News

1. **[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com)** – One of the most comprehensive financial news outlets. Stocks recently closed at record highs with tech leading the way, and the Nasdaq gained 8% in May. CNBC covers all of this and more in real time.

2. **[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/stock-market-news/)** – A great hub for stock market updates. The May nonfarm payrolls report and Broadcom earnings are currently in focus for investors.

3. **[CNN Markets](https://www.cnn.com/markets)** – CNN provides up-to-date stock market data coverage, including the latest updates on US markets, world markets, stock quotes, crypto, commodities, and currencies.

4. **[Nasdaq.com](https://www.nasdaq.com)** – Get the latest stock market news, stock information & quotes, data analysis reports, as well as a general overview of the market landscape from Nasdaq.

5. **[Morningstar](https://www.morningstar.com/markets)** – Great for in-depth analysis. They cover topics like earnings reports, market trends, and investment insights.

6. **[NYSE](https://www.nyse.com/index)** – The official New York Stock Exchange website provides market recaps and insights. For the most recent week, the S&P 500 ended up over 1%, hitting yet another record high and closing in on the next whole number milestone at 7600.

7. **[Edward Jones – Daily Market Recap](https://www.edwardjones.com/us-en/market-news-insights/stock-market-news/daily-market-recap)** – Stay up to date with the latest developments, trends, and daily insights on the market, including a comprehensive look at market movements, international updates, economic indicators, and expert analysis.

### 🔑 Key Market Highlights Right Now:
- Stocks have been adding to gains on Middle East ceasefire optimism, with major equity indexes posting their ninth consecutive weekly gain.
- AI-driven demand continues to support earnings, as illustrated by a 30% jump in shares of Dell Technologies, which delivered a sales outlook well above consensus estimates driven by strong demand for AI-related server infrastructure.

These sources will keep you well-informed about the stock market on a daily basis!
